messages.text: Good day! We are NexaDoc Solutions Sri Lanka. We urgently require 15 home-based typists to convert scanned PDF documents into Word format.
Hello, I can type 55 wpm. What is the rate per page?
We pay 150 LKR per completed page. Each assignment has 40 pages, so you earn 6,000 LKR per assignment. Delivery time is 4 days.
That works for me. Can you send the sample file?
Before we release the client's confidential source files, you must transfer a refundable security deposit of 4,000 LKR. This ensures files are not leaked or left unfinished.
Is the security deposit compulsory? I haven't paid deposits for freelance work before.
Yes, it is 100% refundable with your first payout of 6,000 LKR + 4,000 LKR = 10,000 LKR. We will issue an official company voucher.
Can I provide an ID copy instead of cash deposit?
Sorry candidate, system requires the transaction reference number to unlock the file server at https://nexadoc.example/tasks. Please deposit to our finance agent today to book your slot.

messages.text: Congratulations on completing your trial run with QuickMerchant Global! Your tester balance currently stands at 14,200 LKR.
Thank you! I was surprised how fast the orders processed. How do I transfer the money to my Commercial Bank account?
Please go to https://qm-workstation.example/wallet and select Withdraw.
It is showing an error: 'Withdrawal frozen. Minimum tax clearance quota needed'.
Yes, because your account is in Tier-1 probationary mode. You need to remit a 15% clearance fee of 2,130 LKR to unlock the channel.
Why didn't you mention this earlier? Can't you simply deduct 2,130 from the 14,200?
The smart contract requires external funding to verify your account legitimacy. As soon as the transfer of 2,130 LKR is verified, the entire 16,330 LKR will be credited to you immediately.
This sounds suspicious. I am not sending any money.
If you do not complete the clearance within 3 hours, your dashboard earnings will be forfeited permanently under merchant guidelines.

Security caution money kiyanne mokakda? Wadeta salli illanne ai?

Eka mata aith hambenawada work deliver kalama?

messages.text: Good morning! Are you still seeking remote opportunities? We have vacancies for Online Survey Evaluators at Lanka Insights.

Around 8 to 10 surveys per day. Each takes 5 minutes and pays 350 LKR. You can easily make around 3,500 LKR daily.
That would help me a lot. Do I need to submit my CV?
No CV required. Direct enrollment is open today. You just need to fill the candidate bio form at https://survey-lanka.example/onboard.
Okay, opened the link. But section 3 asks for a 1,500 LKR account setup fee payment slip.

I thought legitimate job vacancies do not charge applicants for registration?
This is not a job charge, it covers the third-party software licensing fee for your private dashboard. You will recover it on your very first day of evaluations.
